# Draft:Kingdom Of Heavenly God Band

Was an Indorock band formed in Soerabaja, Java, Dutch East Indies (now Surabaya, Java, Indonesia) from 20 January 1934 until 31 December 2029.
Final members:
Draft:Greta Dado -  piano, bass guitar, rhythm guitar, vocals, management (20.1.1934-31.12.2029), lead guitar (17.7.1982-31.12.2029), drums (3.3.2025-31.12.2029) (Nation: Indonesia 🇮🇩) (Born 19.1.1933)
2. Draft:Johannes Medardus Luisterberg - drums (20.1.1934-3.3.2025, died 3.3.2025) (26.6.1928-3.3.2025) (Nation: Indonesia 🇮🇩)
& 3. Draft:Carl Schilling - lead guitar (20.1.1934-17.7.1982, died 17.7.1982) (4.11.1930-17.7.1982) (Nation: Indonesia 🇮🇩)
